items.headline: Singapore Banks Post Mixed 1H26 Results; DBS and OCBC Outperform Expectations
items.summary: <cite index="1-1,1-5">DBS and OCBC outperformed expectations while UOB posted results broadly in line with analyst expectations in 2QFY2026 ended June 30, mainly thanks to non-interest income including wealth fees</cite>.

items.headline: 1Q26 Results: DBS Posts Record Profit, OCBC Gains 5%, UOB Declines 4%
items.summary: <cite index="4-2,4-15,4-17">DBS reported net profit of S$2.93 billion in 1Q26 up 1% YoY, OCBC's net profit rose 5% YoY to S$1.97 billion, while UOB's net profit declined 4% YoY to S$1.44 billion</cite>.

items.headline: Singtel Weighs Potential IPO for India Data Centre Business
items.summary: <cite index="11-1">Singtel weighs a potential IPO for its India data centre business under its Nxera data centre services subsidiary</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines Approves Special Dividend of 7 Cents Per Share
items.summary: <cite index="22-5">Singapore Airlines Limited at its AGM held on July 24, 2026 approved a special dividend of 7 cents per ordinary share for the year ended 31 March 2026</cite>.

items.headline: Keppel Receives S$1 Billion in Cash Proceeds from M1 Telecom Divestment
items.summary: <cite index="19-1,19-2">Keppel announced its proposed divestment of M1's telecommunications business to Simba Telecom for an enterprise value of around S$1.4 billion, with Keppel to receive close to S$1 billion in cash proceeds for its 83.9% effective stake</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Stock Market Stabilizes Near 5,675 Points; Further Upside Expected
items.summary: <cite index="25-1,25-3">The Singapore stock market finished higher in two of three trading days after dropping 85 points (1.7%), with the global forecast for Asian markets upbeat as easing crude oil prices allayed inflation and interest rate concerns</cite>.

items.headline: Big Tech Market Caps Shift Following Earnings; Nearly $2 Trillion in Valuation Changes
items.summary: <cite index="31-2,31-3">Nearly $2 trillion moved in or out of six megacaps reporting earnings, with Amazon, Microsoft and Google adding hundreds of billions to market caps, while Apple and Meta saw valuations fall</cite>.

items.headline: Big Tech AI Monetization Divergence: Cloud Giants Outperform Consumer/Advertising Companies
items.summary: <cite index="34-3,34-5">Recent Big Tech earnings reveal investors rewarding companies that successfully monetize AI, with Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon impressing Wall Street with strong cloud and AI growth, while Meta, Apple and Tesla faced pressure</cite>.

items.headline: Nvidia Benefits from Major Clients' AI Capex Surge; Data Center Revenue Accelerates
items.summary: <cite index="33-4,33-16">NVIDIA posted record quarterly revenue of $81.6 billion with data center at $75.2 billion (+92% YoY), driven almost entirely by AI data center GPUs as clients significantly increase AI infrastructure spending</cite>.

items.headline: Tesla Capex to Exceed $25 Billion in 2026 Amid AI Strategy Ramp; Stock Under Pressure
items.summary: <cite index="43-6,43-9">Tesla's capex is expected to exceed $25 billion this year as it ramps investment across AI infrastructure and robotics, with the stock logging its worst week in over a month, declining more than 6%</cite>.

items.headline: Elon Musk Urges Berkshire Hathaway CEO Buffett to Invest in Tesla
items.summary: <cite index="41-6,41-7,41-8">Tesla CEO Elon Musk posted that Berkshire Hathaway CEO Warren Buffett should purchase a stake in Tesla, calling it an 'obvious move'</cite>, though <cite index="44-1">as of the most recent public disclosures, Berkshire Hathaway does not hold a direct, reportable stake in Tesla</cite>.

items.headline: US Markets Remain Near All-Time Highs Amid Geopolitical Tensions and Oil Price Volatility
items.summary: <cite index="32-2,32-7">The major U.S. stock indexes are sitting near all-time highs despite war with Iran, rising oil prices and dismal consumer sentiment readings</cite>.
